data.name: Twisted Worlds
data.detailed_description:
Travel back in time and reconstruct the world chronology in Twisted Worlds. Explore whimsical hidden object locations in two dimensions and save the day!

Features:
  • The most extraordinary hidden object casual game!
  • Unparalleled time travel to save the world
  • Breathtaking cutscenes, animations and HOS visuals
  • Real and magic worlds to explore
  • A must for sci-fi geeks, history buffs and hidden object games fans!
  • A cast of mysterious creatures to guide you
  • Over 20 changing locations to explore in two worlds
  • Over 10 Hidden Object modes for devoted finding games fans
  • Over 2000 tasks which disclose true historical events and forecasts for the future
  • Unique mechanics of crafting boosters from the found ingredients
  • Over 1100 days of gameplay for mystery games geeks

    An unknown event dated back at the turn of the common era affected the timeline and caused the two worlds collide. Now you must start the time machine and find hidden objects associated with the core events of the passed years to reconstruct the world chronology. Beware! The brink between the two worlds has become too vague, so, no one could predict what reality you end up at your next time leap. Any seek-and-find location may appear in its true or mystic perspective, while the item list is presented as either letters, numbers or symbols. Cleverly hidden on the scene, they are scattered randomly each time you enter the location, providing limitless i-spy experience.

    As you journey to the past, you will collect souvenirs from each year you come to be in order to complete different tasks and earn experience points. As you progress through the storyline, you will witness the development of the modern civilization in its various aspects – science, technology, philosophy, politics, art and more. Each collection you complete displays the evolution of a particular instrument of human culture and make an assumption of its further advance.

    It’s time for the quest of your life! Find yourself in a twisted reality, search for hidden symbols, decipher the meaning of the secret numbers and open the gate to the future in this breathtaking sci-fi adventure game!

Solve thrilling puzzles and investigate hidden object scenes as you journey into the unknown.

movies.name: Twisted Worlds - the most extraordinary hidden object game!

reviews.review:
Twisted Worlds is a free-to-play hidden object adventure developed and published by Absolutist Ltd. that blends fantasy, history, science fiction, and puzzle-solving into a surprisingly ambitious casual gaming experience. While many hidden object titles focus primarily on isolated mysteries and standalone locations, Twisted Worlds attempts to build a much larger narrative centered on time travel, alternate realities, and the preservation of human history. The result is a game that offers considerably more scope than many of its genre counterparts while maintaining the accessible gameplay that hidden object fans expect.

The story revolves around a catastrophic disruption in the timeline that has caused reality itself to become unstable. Historical events, magical realms, and alternate dimensions begin colliding with one another, threatening the natural flow of history. Players are tasked with traveling through different periods of civilization in an effort to restore balance and prevent the collapse of both the real world and a parallel magical universe. This premise provides a strong sense of purpose and gives the adventure a larger narrative framework than many casual puzzle games.

One of the game's most distinctive features is its use of historical exploration. As players progress through the storyline, they visit locations inspired by different eras and cultures, encountering references to important moments in human development. The game incorporates themes involving science, philosophy, art, politics, and technological advancement, creating an educational undertone that complements the fantasy narrative. While the historical elements are simplified for accessibility, they add an extra layer of interest that helps distinguish the game from more conventional hidden object adventures.

The hidden object gameplay remains the core attraction. Players search detailed environments for carefully concealed items while completing objectives tied to the larger storyline. The scenes are densely populated with objects, encouraging careful observation and attention to detail. To prevent the gameplay from becoming repetitive, the game frequently introduces different search formats. Items may be represented through words, silhouettes, symbols, or alternative clues, forcing players to adapt their approach and remain engaged.

Exploration is enhanced by the concept of two interconnected worlds. Locations often exist in both a historical reality and a magical counterpart, each presenting unique visual themes and gameplay opportunities. Revisiting familiar areas under different circumstances helps create variety and reinforces the central narrative about worlds merging together. This mechanic gives the environments greater depth and allows the game to make creative use of its settings.

Beyond hidden object scenes, players encounter a variety of puzzles and mini-games. These challenges typically involve logic, pattern recognition, matching mechanics, and environmental problem-solving. While the puzzles are generally designed to remain accessible to casual audiences, they provide enough diversity to break up the core search gameplay and maintain a steady pace. Their inclusion helps the experience feel more like a complete adventure rather than a simple collection of hidden object levels.

Progression is built around a large number of objectives, collections, and unlockable content. Players gather artifacts, complete missions, earn rewards, and gradually expand their access to new areas. The collection system is particularly noteworthy because it encourages exploration and provides additional goals beyond advancing the main story. Completionists will find plenty of reasons to continue playing as they attempt to uncover every collectible and finish every available task.

Visually, Twisted Worlds succeeds in creating colorful and imaginative environments. Historical locations, magical landscapes, and fantastical settings are filled with decorative details that make them enjoyable to explore. The artwork is vibrant and varied, helping each location feel distinct from the last. Although the graphics are not technically groundbreaking, they effectively support the game's adventurous tone and contribute to its sense of wonder.

The atmosphere benefits greatly from the fusion of fantasy and history. Players constantly move between realistic environments and magical distortions, creating a sense of unpredictability that keeps the adventure fresh. The narrative's focus on time travel and alternate realities allows for considerable variety, ensuring that the game rarely feels confined to a single visual or thematic style.

Like many free-to-play hidden object games, Twisted Worlds is not entirely free from repetition. Some objectives require revisiting locations multiple times, and the progression structure occasionally relies on repeated searches to unlock new content. Players looking for a tightly focused narrative may also find the sheer volume of side activities somewhat overwhelming. However, for fans of the genre, these systems often provide the long-term engagement that hidden object adventures are known for.

What ultimately makes Twisted Worlds memorable is the ambition behind its concept. By combining time travel, historical exploration, magical fantasy, and hidden object gameplay into a single adventure, it creates a world that feels larger and more imaginative than many comparable titles. The educational elements, narrative scope, and diverse environments help elevate it beyond a standard casual puzzle experience.

For players who enjoy hidden object games with strong progression systems and expansive settings, Twisted Worlds offers a rewarding journey filled with mystery, exploration, and discovery. Its combination of imaginative storytelling, varied gameplay mechanics, historical themes, and extensive content provides many hours of entertainment. While the repetitive nature of some activities may not appeal to everyone, fans of casual adventure games will likely find plenty to enjoy within its richly detailed and creatively designed world.

Rating: 6/10
